fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that members of a chit group near Poongodi Layout Residential Colony reported that the organiser stopped payouts, with the complainant owed about Rs. 50,000. The matter was brought to Tiruppur Central PS on 2025-07-06, while the incident was placed on 2025-07-01 at approximately 10:05. Contact details given by the complainant, Uma Raj, include the number 9000000089. A witness, Vignesh Balan, reachable on 9000000105, was mentioned in the complaint. The account reference SYN-ACC-100076 was noted in connection with the payment. The complaint mentions Mohan Sekar, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000168, in connection with the events. Items referenced in the complaint: a call detail reference and mobile phone records.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Call detail reference; Mobile phone record
fields.Modus_Operandi: Chit contributions reportedly collected in cash and through transfers.
fields.Keywords: chit fund, financial fraud, morning, residential colony, mobile number, phone records, suspect, witness
